name: Any-Shape purpose
statement: Preserve the meaning, usability and recognizable visual identity of an interface while its geometry and environment change.
purpose: Enable context-sensitive reflow rather than fixed screen templates.
Keep content and actions understandable, accessible and reachable across practical display shapes.
Provide observable, privacy-safe evidence of layout failures so independent implementations can be evaluated.
Make behavior recoverable independently of the original language, tools, library and author.
priorities: meaning and interaction over pixel positions
low resource cost and no mandatory telemetry
nonGoals: guarantee aesthetic perfection under all geometries
replicate exactly matching pixels on different rendering systems
replace HTML or the browser layout engine
require a specific frontend framework or runtime
conceal primary content to satisfy a viewport
supportedEnvironments: standards-compliant browsers and equivalent interface-rendering systems; implementation adapters may vary
